sents.en: Saturn is a planet.
Planets orbit stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Saturn is the sixth closest planet to the sun.
sents.ko: 토성은 태양에서 여섯 번째로 가까운 행성이에요.

sents.en: Saturn is 887 million miles (1.2 billion km) from the sun.
Saturn fully orbits the sun every 29 years.
sents.ko: 토성은 29년마다 태양을 완전히 한 바퀴 돌아요.

sents.en: One year on Saturn is 29 years on Earth.
Saturn spins while in orbit.
sents.ko: 토성은 궤도를 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: One full spin takes about 11 hours.
sents.ko: 한 바퀴 회전하는 데 약 11시간이 걸려요.

sents.en: One day on Saturn is 11 hours on Earth.
Saturn is a giant ball of gas.
You cannot stand on Saturn.
Jupiter, Uranus, and Neptune are also made of gases.
sents.ko: 목성, 천왕성, 해왕성도 기체로 되어 있어요.

sents.en: Rings surround Saturn.
The rings are made of rocks and ice.
Some pieces are the size of dust.
Others are as big as cars.
The rings reflect the sun's light.
This makes Saturn very colorful.
Saturn has many moons.
Scientists have counted over 60.
Saturn's largest moon is Titan.
You can see Saturn from Earth on a clear night.
sents.ko: 맑은 밤에 지구에서 토성을 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: You will not need a telescope!
Wow, Saturn is so beautiful.
I would love to go there.
But it's so far away from Earth.
Will you help me find my way there?
sents.ko: 거기 가는 길을 찾는 걸 도와줄래요?

sents.en: Really? Good! Let's go!
